dedupe_keys.name: edgar emissions database for global atmospheric research global greenhouse gas and air pollutant emissions by country sector and grid edgar 2026 ghg

description: EDGAR is the JRC's independent global database of human-made greenhouse gas and air pollutant emissions, built with international statistics and a consistent IPCC method, not from national reporting. Coverage: all countries; the 2026 GHG release gives CO2 (fossil, as the joint IEA-EDGAR dataset, and biogenic separately), CH4, N2O and fluorinated gases by sector and country from 1970 to 2025 (F-gases from 1990), with the latest years extended by a fast-track method; sectors follow IPCC 1996 and 2006 codes and include fossil fuel combustion, cement and metal production, flaring, waste and wastewater, agriculture and international shipping; activity data come from IEA energy balances, FAOSTAT, USGS, worldsteel and others. Format and access: annual country and sector tables (XLSX in ZIP, kilotonnes per year), monthly tables, and annual and sector-specific gridmaps at 0.1 by 0.1 degree in TXT and NetCDF, downloaded without login from the JRC open data FTP; a data explorer and country fact sheets; separate air pollutant releases (v8.1) and the HTAPv3 mosaic. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for material owned by the EU; the fossil CO2 component includes IEA data as modified by the JRC, and each dataset page sets the citation and conditions. Caveats: large-scale biomass burning and land use change (LULUCF) are excluded from the GHG totals; estimates can differ from national inventories. Simulation uses: sector emission baselines and gridded emission maps for decarbonisation scenarios of energy, transport and industrial infrastructure. Related records: EDGAR-FOOD (data-edgar-food) and the worldsteel statistics (data-worldsteel-steel-statistics) used as activity data.
